about.title: Engineering for the long term.
about.lead: MukiSoft is a software engineering and digital technology company. We design, build and operate modern software, AI features and digital products for businesses that take technology seriously.
about.principlesLead: How MukiSoft thinks about engineering, AI and product work — and the principles that keep our work honest.
about.heroSubtitle: {company} is an established software and digital technology company founded in {year} and headquartered in {location}.
about.whoWeAreTitle: An international software and digital technology company.
about.whoWeAreParagraph1: {company} is an established software and digital technology company founded in {year} and headquartered in {location}.
about.whoWeAreParagraph2: We develop technology solutions across software engineering, web and mobile development, artificial intelligence, SaaS, product design, automation and digital growth.
about.whoWeAreParagraph3: Our work is guided by a simple principle: technology should create measurable value for the people and organisations that use it.
about.storyTitle: A focused software initiative, evolved into a technology organisation.
about.storyLead: Since {year}, {company} has developed its engineering capability, technology direction and product thinking — phase by phase.
about.missionDefault: To build reliable, accessible and thoughtfully engineered digital solutions that help businesses and organisations grow in a technology-driven world.
about.visionDefault: To grow into a trusted global technology partner known for engineering meaningful software products, intelligent digital solutions and long-term client relationships.
about.valuesTitle: What guides every engagement, every decision, every line of code.
about.valuesLead: The principles that shape how {company} works with clients, partners and each other.
about.capabilitiesTitle: End-to-end capability across the digital product lifecycle.
about.capabilitiesLead: {company} works across software, design and emerging technology — bringing engineering, product and design thinking into a single organisation.
about.approachLead: {company} approaches every engagement with the discipline of a long-term partner. Our delivery model is built around clarity, accountability and engineering depth.
about.principleClarityDesc: We invest time upfront so the rest of the work is faster, calmer and more accurate.
about.principleUsabilityDesc: Useful, accessible products earn adoption. Engineering quality is built around real users.
about.principleMaintainabilityDesc: Software lives for years. We write code and design systems the team can evolve after we leave.

founder.title: Leadership.
founder.lead: The leadership team behind MukiSoft — engineering, product, applied AI and the operations that make software work.
founder.heroSubtitle: {company} is led by {name}, {role} — providing strategic and technical leadership across the organisation's engineering, platform and technology direction since {year}.
founder.focusLead: The areas where {name} provides strategic and technical leadership across {company}'s engineering and product direction.
founder.philosophyParagraph1: We lead with calm, clarity and accountability. Decisions are made with as much information as we can responsibly gather — but we don't pretend to know more than we do.
founder.philosophyParagraph2: We invest in people and protect their time, energy and judgement. We believe the best work comes from teams who are trusted, equipped and respected.
founder.philosophyParagraph3: We choose long-term thinking over short-term wins — even when it would be easier not to.
founder.recognitionBody: Education, working focus, and how to reach {name} are summarised in the panel on this page. Public bios and full leadership philosophy are kept on the
founder.quote: Software is most useful when it is engineered carefully, by organisations that care — and used by people who feel that care in every interaction.
founder.buildTitle: Have an idea, product or business challenge? Connect with {shortName} Technology to discuss how we can engineer it into a reliable digital solution.
founder.buildBody: Reach out directly — every serious inquiry is read and responded to.

team.heroSubtitle: The engineering capability behind {company} — senior-led and cross-functional, building software for businesses that take engineering seriously.

team.leadershipFounderParagraph: {company} is led by {name} — {position} and the senior technical authority on every engagement. Leadership sets the engineering direction, the quality bar, and the way the company works with its clients.
team.leadershipGenericParagraph: {company} is led by senior practitioners who set the engineering direction, the quality bar, and the way the company works with its clients.
team.leadershipFollowup: Behind that leadership, {company} brings together the engineering capability that ambitious digital products require — product engineering, design, AI, cloud and operations.

team.leadershipPlaceholderBody: Leadership profiles will appear here once published from the admin panel.

team.capabilityLead: {company} organises engineering around the capabilities modern digital products require. The practices below are built into every project — and into how the team works together.

team.operateBody: The team operates with a small, async-first cadence — written by default, with overlap hours for high-bandwidth conversations. See the
team.operateBodySuffix: page for the full operating principles.
team.workWithTitle: Have a project that needs a senior team?
team.workWithBody: {company} works with founders, operators and product teams who value clarity, craftsmanship and senior accountability. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear about the work.
team.capabilityEngineeringDesc: Senior technical leadership sets the direction on every engagement — from architecture decisions to release readiness.
team.capabilityProductDesc: Cross-functional engineering teams that can take a product from problem statement to production operation.
team.capabilityDesignDesc: Research-led product design grounded in user needs, accessibility and long-term brand consistency.
team.capabilityAiDesc: Practitioners who design AI features responsibly — grounded in real data, with the right guardrails around them.
team.capabilityCloudDesc: Engineers who design cloud and infrastructure topologies with observability, security and reliability built in.
team.capabilityQualityDesc: Quality engineering, automation and operational practices that protect the product long after launch.

process.principlesLead: Three principles that shape every engagement.
process.principleWorkingDesc: Visible progress and working increments — never long quiet periods between updates.
process.principleReportingDesc: Transparent progress, risks and trade-offs — communicated clearly, even when the news is hard.
process.principleQualityDesc: Architecture, testing and accessibility built in from day one, not bolted on at the end.

services.metaDescription: {company} — technology capabilities for a digital world. Software engineering, web platforms, mobile applications, AI, SaaS, product design, automation, cloud and digital growth for modern businesses.

careers.lead: MukiSoft hires senior engineers, designers and operators who care about the craft of building serious software.

careers.noOpenRolesBody: We are always interested in meeting senior engineers, designers and operators. Reach out and tell us about your work.
careers.metaDescription: Careers at {company} — join a senior engineering organisation that builds modern software, AI and digital products for businesses worldwide.

careers.workLead: Our culture is intentionally quiet — built on engineering craft, honesty and respect for each other's time.

benefits.remoteDesc: Work from where you do your best thinking — an international organisation with intentional overlap hours.
benefits.seniorsDesc: No layered hierarchy — engineers, designers and AI practitioners work together across projects.
benefits.ownershipDesc: Decision-making authority and clear accountability from day one.
benefits.learningDesc: Time and budget for conferences, courses and the tools you need to grow.
benefits.horizonDesc: We optimise for products and relationships that last across years.
benefits.internationalDesc: Real exposure to international clients and engineering challenges.

principles.craftDesc: We choose boring-on-purpose defaults where reliability matters, and modern approaches where they clearly pay off.
principles.asyncDesc: We default to written, asynchronous work with intentional overlap hours for high-bandwidth conversations.
principles.feedbackDesc: We share what we know and what we don't. We give clear, kind, actionable feedback — and expect the same in return.
principles.outcomesDesc: We measure success by shipped impact and the businesses we help grow — not by lines of code or vanity metrics.

contact.title: Start a Conversation.
contact.subtitle: Tell {company} about your product, your team, or the technology problem you are trying to solve. {company} works with businesses, founders and product teams that take software seriously.
contact.formLead: The more context you can share, the more useful {company}'s reply will be. Submitting the form opens your email client with your message addressed to {company}.
contact.internationalBody: {company} works with clients across borders, time zones and industries — combining modern communication, remote-first delivery and a global mindset.
contact.engagementTitle: What happens after you reach out.
contact.engagementLead: We treat every serious inquiry as a conversation, not a sales call. Here is what working with {company} looks like in practice.
contact.step1Title: A reply within one business day
contact.step1Desc: Every inquiry receives a thoughtful reply — not an auto-responder — within one business day.
contact.step2Desc: A 30–45 minute conversation to understand the problem, the user, the constraints, and the right shape for the engagement.

privacy.s1Body: {company} ("we", "our", "us") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect when you use {domain}, how we use it, and the choices you have.
privacy.s2Body1: We collect information you provide directly to us — for example when you submit a contact form, request a proposal or communicate with us by email. This may include your name, email address, company, role and the content of your message.
privacy.s2Body2: We also collect limited technical information automatically when you visit our website — such as your IP address, browser type and the pages you view — to help us operate, secure and improve the site.
privacy.s3Body: We use the information we collect to respond to inquiries, deliver and improve our services, send relevant communications, and comply with our legal obligations. We do not sell personal information.
privacy.s4Body: We may use cookies or similar technologies to operate our website, remember preferences and analyse traffic. You can control cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.s5Body: We do not sell personal information. We may share information with service providers who help us operate our business (for example email or hosting providers), or where required by law.
privacy.s6Body: {company} is based in {location} and operates as a remote-first company. We may process information in multiple countries. By using our services you understand that your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own.
privacy.s7Body: You may request access to or deletion of your personal information by contacting us at
privacy.s8Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be available on this page, with the "last updated" date below.

terms.s1Body: By accessing this website or engaging {company} for services, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions.
terms.s2Body: Specific services, deliverables, timelines and fees are agreed in a separate written agreement or proposal. In the event of a conflict between these terms and the executed agreement, the executed agreement prevails.
terms.s3Body: Unless otherwise agreed in writing, deliverables produced for a client are assigned to the client upon full payment. Pre-existing tools, libraries and frameworks remain the property of their respective owners. The {company} brand, logo and website content remain the property of {legalName}.
terms.s4Body: Both parties agree to keep confidential information confidential and to use it only for the purposes of performing the engagement.
terms.s5Body: Services are provided with reasonable skill and care. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we disclaim all other warranties and limit our liability as set out in the executed agreement.
terms.s6Body: Either party may terminate an engagement in accordance with the terms of the executed agreement. Termination does not affect rights or obligations that have accrued prior to termination.
terms.s7Body: These terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction set out in the executed agreement. If no jurisdiction is specified, the governing law is the operating location of {legalName}.
